Name: Dalmatian Dog Replacement
Author: Pedroocm
Description:
It's my first retexture mod, so please don't be so upset if you don't like it, but you can leave a suggestion/opinion for me.
I have a dalmatian and I tought the game would be more fun if my dog was one too, then I had the idea to make a mod myself, as I wasn't finding any replacement of a dalmatian.
If you don't know how to replace your original files with this one, here's a quick tutorial:
- First download the Zip file here on NexusMods (Just click on "FILES" and then "download manually")
- After it download just unzip it (By clicking on the option afer clicking on the folder with right-click)
- Copy the XNB file (named "dog")
- Then just find your Stardew Valley's folder (If you have it on steam, it looks like this : Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\ )
- Click on the folder "Content" and then "Animals"
- Before you replace, make sure you have a backup of your Content's folder
- After that, just copy the file on that folder (the "Animals" one), it will ask if you want to replace and just say yes.
Play your game and enjoy your new dalmatian! :D
